title: Chhota Bheem: The Blue Mountain
overview: Chhota Bheem and his close friends travel to Neeli Pahadi to save Dholakpur from Patalpur, a man who is planning a secret attack to destroy the village.

songs.title: Chhota Bheem & Krishna vs Zimbara
songs.singers: Chhota Bheem, Krishna The Great, Sudesh Bhosle, Oushnik Majumdar
